name: 02_strokes
prompt: A specimen sheet of fifteen isolated oil-paint brushstrokes on a fully transparent background, arranged in a loose 5 by 3 grid with generous empty space between every stroke so that no two strokes touch. Each stroke is thick Van Gogh-style impasto in creamy titanium white paint: a single loaded swipe with deep bristle grooves, raised glossy ridges and a ragged dry-brush tail, lit by soft raking light from the upper left so the relief is clearly visible. Varied shapes: short square dabs, long gently curved strokes, comma strokes, tapered petal-like strokes, short hatched marks. Sharp focus, straight-on view, no canvas, no shadow on the background, no text.
